summary: Implementation remains blocked on a supported Blacksmith pre-worker dispatch association and terminal-status contract. Current main preserves the reported observation gap. No code changes or PR are proposed; keep the issue open.

actions.reason: Keep the issue open as the canonical tracking thread, with a non-mutating classification because no safe fix artifact can be established from the supplied evidence. No supported binding between the Testbox request and its pre-worker workflow run is established by the supplied evidence or current adapter. Guessing by workflow, ref, or time, or accepting native completion as settlement, would violate the existing exact-association contract. Resume implementation when Blacksmith supplies durable request-to-run identity and authoritative terminal status through cancellation and admission failure.
